mapper.sql: case l.operation_type when 1 then '商品审核' when 2 then '卖家认证审核' when 3 then '举报处理' else '未知类型' end

case when l.operation_type = 1 then concat( '商品：', ifnull(g.title, concat('商品#', l.target_id)), '；发布人：', ifnull(gu.name, '-') ) when l.operation_type = 2 then concat( '申请人：', ifnull(ifnull(sa.real_name, su.name), concat('认证#', l.target_id)), '；学号：', ifnull(sa.student_no, '-') ) when l.operation_type = 3 then concat( '举报对象：', case r.target_type when 1 then ifnull(concat('商品 ', rg.title), concat('商品#', r.target_id)) when 2 then ifnull(concat('用户 ', ru.name), concat('用户#', r.target_id)) when 3 then concat('消息#', ifnull(cast(r.target_id as char), '-')) else concat('举报#', l.target_id) end ) else concat('对象#', l.target_id) end

l.id as id, l.admin_id as adminId, coalesce(nullif(l.admin_name, ''), a.name, concat('管理员#', l.admin_id)) as adminName, l.operation_type as operationType, as operationTypeDesc, l.target_id as targetId, as targetSummary, l.action as action, l.detail as detail, l.create_time as createTime

from audit_log l left join admin a on l.admin_id = a.id left join goods g on l.operation_type = 1 and l.target_id = g.id left join `user` gu on g.seller_id = gu.id left join sellerauth sa on l.operation_type = 2 and l.target_id = sa.id left join `user` su on sa.user_id = su.id left join report r on l.operation_type = 3 and l.target_id = r.id left join goods rg on r.target_type = 1 and r.target_id = rg.id left join `user` ru on r.target_type = 2 and r.target_id = ru.id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO audit_log (admin_id, admin_name, operation_type, target_id, action, detail, create_time, update_time, create_user, update_user) VALUES (#{adminId}, #{adminName}, #{operationType}, #{targetId}, #{action}, #{detail}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime}, #{createUser}, #{updateUser})
